title: Gate Synthesis in Dephasing-Limited Nitrogen-Vacancy Ensembles
summary: Ensemble nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers are widely used for quantum sensing and magnetometry, where performance depends on the accurate implementation of microwave pulse sequences. In these systems, inhomogeneous broadening and short coherence times limit reliable multi-pulse control, while hardware imperfections and off-resonant excitation distort implemented rotations, making direct calibration of arbitrary gates tedious.
